title: Admit context-operational owner bindings

artifact_type.representation_note: The decision record format remains a local bootstrap candidate; authority comes from the exact user selection bound to the admitted bootstrap owner identity.

selection.selected_authority: admitted bootstrap owner identity for cal.artifact-type.owner-registry/v1
selection.selection_source: Exact user instruction ADMIT-CTX02-OPERATIONAL-OWNERS-V1 in the active task.
selection.rationale: Activate the separately scoped operational owners required before Governance and Ontology Lifecycle context candidates may be authored.

authority_basis.non_effect: The ten proposed roles did not authorize their own admission; authority derives from the previously admitted bootstrap owner identity.

admitted_operational_roles.effect: Own cross-context architecture, independent identity axes, recursion boundaries, and repository placement policy.
Own the Governance Bounded Context identity, semantic boundary, model scope, contracts, and challenge route.
Own the Ontology Lifecycle Bounded Context identity, semantic boundary, event-history and replay model, contracts, and challenge route.
Own Governance context-local terminology, expressions, relations, interpretations, and ambiguity handling.
Own Ontology Lifecycle context-local terminology, expressions, relations, interpretations, and ambiguity handling.
Own recursive coordination-context identity, purpose, subject scope, consumers, and bounded-context membership.
Own Context Map membership and explicit directional relationship contracts between exact context versions.
Own exact capability-instance identity, extension scope, recursion stop, and instance-local authority claim.
Own context migration intent, dispositions, dependency order, expected postimages, rollback boundary, and required gates.
Own historical predecessor-successor context identity evidence, preserved and changed scope, and challenge route.

materialization.rule: The immutable successor registry is the current owner-registry overlay. Its five predecessor assignments remain active and its ten added assignments become active only through this decision.
materialization.decision_separation: The same principal holds multiple roles, but each future decision must name exactly one applicable role and satisfy that role's separate evidence and claim ceiling.

excluded_effects: No Bounded Context, Coordination Context, Ubiquitous Language, Context Map, Capability Instance, Context Migration Manifest, or Context Lineage Record instance is authored or admitted.
No Governance to Ontology Lifecycle relationship pattern is selected.
No source selector, Product Capability, DomainSpec source, system ontology, implementation binding, or conformance claim is admitted by this owner decision.
No migration execution, destructive action, publication, deployment, external effect, or stable release is authorized or performed.
successor_obligations: Re-enter routing before authoring context or language candidates.
Author Governance and Ontology Lifecycle Bounded Context candidates with their separate context-owner roles.
Author one Ubiquitous Language candidate for each context under its context-local language owner.
Keep context and language admission, Context Map pattern selection, capability-instance binding, and migration execution as separate later gates.
claim_ceiling: This decision activates only ten exact operational role bindings through the immutable owner-registry successor while preserving five Foundation roles. It does not create or admit context-metamodel instances, select their relationships, authorize migration or implementation, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
